name: Gpos Geospatially Aware Proof Of Stake 4C1A4F6B
text: GPoS: Geospatially-aware Proof of Stake reports a distinct concentration mechanism in proof-of-stake consensus. Across Aptos, Avalanche, Ethereum, Solana, and Sui, a few geographic regions dominate consensus voting power. The study reports limited geospatial decentralization and tests a geospatially aware voting design. Its experiments report a 45 percent average improvement in geospatial decentralization with minimal overhead in the tested BFT protocols. Kaal's claim that token-weighted proof-of-stake governance can concentrate control is extended along a geographic dimension. That extension does not validate the wealth-based mechanism. Only the Crossref-indexed abstract passed because the ACM PDF returned HTTP 403. Broader governance outcomes remain unverified.
